===Starting out===
{{Map|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Map of the Quest
|2885,2950,title:Start point,desc:
|2923,3001,title:[[Ah Za Rhoon]],desc:
|2763,2988,title:Tomb of Beverius,desc:
|2921,3084,title:[[Rashiliyia's Tomb]],desc:
|2809,3086,title:[[Trufitus]],desc:

'''Note''': The quest will not be officially started until you have used the [[wampum belt]] on [[Trufitus]].

{{Checklist|
*With one free inventory space, talk to [[Mosol Rei]] outside of Shilo Village. A [[gnome glider]] is nearby, as well as [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CKR}}. {{Chat option|1Why do I need to run?|1Rashiliyia? Who is she?|1What can we do?|4I'll go to see the Shaman|2Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.}}
*Use the [[wampum belt]] on [[Trufitus]], found in the most north-eastern house in [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] (quest icon on minimap). Fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}} is nearby.
*Follow the chat options once you've used the belt on him. {{Chat option|2Mosol Rei said something about a legend?|2Do you know anything more about the temple?|1Tell me more.|3I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!|1Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.}}
}}

===Ah Za Rhoon===
[[File:Ah Za Rhoon map.png|frame|center]]
{{Checklist|
*Head to the temple of [[Ah Za Rhoon]] south-west of the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|Shipyard]] and east of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or Fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKP}}, or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
*Use your spade on the mound of earth.
*Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure, then use your rope on the fissure. '''You will lose the item.'''
*Search the fissure ({{SCP|Agility|32}}) to climb down and follow the cave south until you reach the stream.
* Use your chisel on the stone at 4 to receive a stone-plaque. Read it.
*Search the cave-in at 2 to enter a new cave. {{Chat option|1Yes, I'll wriggle through.}}
*Search the loose rocks at 6 to find a tattered scroll. {{Chat option|1Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.}} '''Read the scroll.'''
*Search the sacks at 7 to find a crumpled scroll. '''Read the scroll.'''
*Search the ancient gallows at 8 to get the [[Zadimus corpse]]. {{Chat option|2Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.}}
*Teleport out, or head back to the first area via the [[Cave in]] at 2.
**If you went back to first area, leave by crafting the broken table at 3 into a raft, or by searching the rocks at 5. You will take heavy damage if you fail the search rocks at 5.
*Return to Trufitus and use the 4 items you have collected on him.
*Head west to the [[Tribal Statue]] near Trufitus' hut and bury the corpse.
*Use the bone shard on Trufitus. {{Chat option|1It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse|1He said something after he gave it to me.|1The spirit said something about keys and kin?}}
}}

===Tomb of Bervirius===
{{Checklist|
*With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to [[Cairn Isle]], west of Shilo Village, near [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|CKR}}. Climb the rocks ({{SCP|Agility|15}}) and then cross the bridge. 
*Search the [[well stacked rocks]] on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring ({{SCP|Agility|32}}). '''If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the scrolls'''. 
*Head south and '''with at least 3 empty inventory spaces''' search the [[tomb dolmen (Tomb of Bervirius)|dolmen]]. If you had no space you'll have to return with [[charcoal]] and [[papyrus]] to get the notes. '''Do not drop the [[locating crystal]] or you will take 5-10 damage'''.
*Use a chisel on the [[sword pommel]].
*Use bronze wire on the bone beads.
*Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).
}}

===Tomb of Rashiliyia===
{{Checklist|*Prepare for the fight against [[Nazastarool]]. [[Crumble Undead]] is useful alongside [[Protect from Melee]].
*With your three regular bones, bone shard and chisel, head south-east from fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKP}} to the north-eastern dot on the Karamja map above.
*Search the unique bright green [[palm tree (Shilo Village)|palm tree]] '''from the north side''' to find two [[carved doors|doors]].
*Search the doors to find the keyhole.
*Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.
*Equip the [[Beads of the dead]] then use the key on the doors.
*Open the ancient gate (while wearing the beads of the dead necklace), then climb down the rocks.
*Run west, south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.
*'''Use''' (don't bury) 3 regular [[bones]] on the [[tomb doors|doors]] (can kill skeletons, '''not zombies''' for the bones if you forgot).
*Search the [[tomb dolmen (Rashiliyia's Tomb)|dolmen]], then defeat Nazastarool in his 3 forms. If you click away from the dialogue at the end of each form, click on the dolmen again to resume the other phases.
**Use [[Protect from Melee]] or stand behind the dolmen to safespot him.
*Take the [[Rashiliyia corpse]].}}

'''Note:''' If you try to leave the cave the way you came in, the door will be locked and Rashiliyia will summon three [[Undead one|Undead ones]] to kill you. You can however still leave by using the bone key on the doors.

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|
*Return to Cairn Isle (fairy ring {{Fairycode|ckr}}).
*Go through the well-stacked rocks.
*Use the corpse on the dolmen.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
